statement: Structured, jury-facing explanation of WHY a formal Pareto frontier is not computed. No frontier is fabricated. Source of truth: results/pareto_decision_inputs.json readiness block.

blockers.summary: Benefits are measured on different datasets/targets with different metrics (HR MAE vs sleep macro-F1); raw magnitudes are not rankable coordinates.
blockers.unlock: Define a per-target comparable benefit frame; never rank raw MAE against macro-F1.

blockers.summary: Only component-IC operating points exist; deployable average power and daily energy are unquantified for every candidate.
blockers.unlock: A compatible operating point + explicit state schedule per candidate to derive average power.

blockers.summary: Incremental finished mass is missing for every candidate (no component/PCB/enclosure selection).

Interaction evidence is now PARTIAL, not absent. One predeclared factorial (Sleep-EDF EEG x EOG x Resp: M0/M_A/M_B/M_AB, 5 seeds, capacity-fair) was run; interaction term approximately zero and unresolved (+0.0031 +/- 0.0434). This covers ONE candidate pair on ONE target and does NOT prove global subset optimality; most candidates remain untested for interaction.
blockers.unlock_met: The prior unlock ('at least one factorial experiment within one dataset/target/protocol') is now satisfied. Remaining: interaction coverage across the other candidate pairs/targets.

blockers.summary: MCU, radio, battery, regulator, enclosure, attachment, and (for second PPG site) module boundary are not selected.
blockers.unlock: A frozen reference BOM / module boundary with shared-resource allocation.

blockers.summary: Sleep/EOG shuffled control, per-subject decomposition, and prospective n=8 secondary holdout are now COMPLETE and integrated (no longer pending), and reproduced exactly from frozen checkpoints in Day-10. The remaining limitation is scope: all Sleep-EDF, same cassette protocol — NOT independent-dataset or cross-population replication. Primary (n=3) and secondary (n=8) are never pooled.
blockers.unlock: Independent-dataset / cross-population sleep replication (out of Day-10 scope; not attempted).

blockers.summary: Only heart rate and (preliminary) sleep stage have marginal-value evidence; other mission-relevant targets are unvalidated.

component_evidence_completeness.note: Mirror of results/pareto_decision_inputs.json readiness.component_matrix (HR components only).

frontal_eog_horizontal.note: Day-10: scientific_benefit upgraded from AVAILABLE_PRELIMINARY (shuffled control + secondary holdout + exact reproduction integrated). contact_burden/module_burden MISSING -> PARTIAL via results/eog_operational_burden_day10.json (2 incremental sensing electrodes, shared-reference head-module path, no new module). compute_data_burden PARTIAL -> AVAILABLE (+112 params/channel, 1 ch x 100 Hz x 24-bit). power/mass remain MISSING (NOT_READY).

day10_updates.interaction_evidence: unavailable -> partial (one controlled EEG x EOG x Resp pair; approximately additive/unresolved)
day10_updates.pareto_status_unchanged: NOT_READY — cross-dataset incomparability, missing system power/mass, incomplete module BOM, and incomplete global interaction coverage remain.
